user_query: What is te average allele frequency for synonymous, moderate, and high-impact variants?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN HighImpact = 1 THEN AF END) AS avg_high_impact,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ModerateImpact = 1 THEN AF END) AS avg_moderate_impact,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Synonymous = 1 THEN AF END) AS avg_synonymous
FROM varInfo_synthetic;

user_query: What is te average allele frequency for synonymous, moderate, and high-impact variants?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN HighImpact = 1 THEN AF END) AS high_impact_avg,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ModerateImpact = 1 THEN AF END) AS moderate_impact_avg,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Synonymous = 1 THEN AF END) AS synonymous_avg
FROM varInfo_synthetic;
